description: Image Description: The image shows a window with two separate panes, each framed in dark brown wood and set into a light gray wall. The window has a horizontal divider and is partially covered by cream-colored curtains that are drawn back on both sides, allowing a view into the room. Inside, two dogs are visible, each positioned behind one of the window panes, resting their heads on the windowsill. The dog on the left appears to be a light golden color with darker markings around its eyes
